simplemaps.guide.page.1.title: Simple Maps
simplemaps.guide.page.1: Wayfinder Maps that show where you have been, a big map screen with waypoints, cartography and map displays on item frames.
simplemaps.guide.page.2.title: Wayfinder maps
simplemaps.guide.page.2: Endless maps, one per dimension: the plain map for the Overworld and other dimensions, a Nether map and an End map.
simplemaps.guide.page.3.title: Mega wayfinder map
simplemaps.guide.page.3: One map for every dimension: buttons in the map screen's title bar switch between the Overworld (grass block), the Nether (netherrack), the End (end stone) and further dimensions; the map remembers the last one.
simplemaps.guide.page.4.title: Picture maps
simplemaps.guide.page.4: Turn a PNG into a wall of locked maps: /simplemaps picture opens a dialog, the picture is split into up to 4 x 4 Vanilla maps that you hang in item frames.
simplemaps.guide.page.5.title: Map screen
simplemaps.guide.page.5: Use the map to open it: drag to move, mouse wheel or +/− to zoom (1, 4, 8, 16 and 64 blocks per pixel).
simplemaps.guide.page.6.title: Claims layer
simplemaps.guide.page.6: With Simple Tweaks installed, the layers button of the map screen offers a Claims layer: claimed land as colored strips on explored terrain, your own land framed.
simplemaps.guide.page.7.title: Waypoints
simplemaps.guide.page.7: Up to eight waypoints belong to the map itself; they show in the locator bar while the map is in the main or off hand.
simplemaps.guide.page.8.title: Cartography table
simplemaps.guide.page.8: Copy, extend and combine wayfinder maps at the cartography table; each can be switched off on the server.
simplemaps.guide.page.9.title: Maps in item frames
simplemaps.guide.page.9: A framed wayfinder map keeps its view until you save a new one: right-click opens the map, the frame's area is outlined, and saving asks once more.
simplemaps.guide.page.10.title: Web map export
simplemaps.guide.page.10: Server admins can export the explored world as a static web map: picture tiles, markers.json and a small viewer page.
simplemaps.guide.page.11.title: Creative tabs
simplemaps.guide.page.11: The module's items sit in its own creative tab only (no Vanilla tabs).
simplemaps.guide.page.12.title: Commands
simplemaps.guide.page.12: /simplemaps config shows and changes every option of config/simplemaps-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simplemaps.guide.page.13.title: Commands
simplemaps.guide.page.13: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once; options read only at start say so. Permission level 2.
